location: D-B, 4191; ex Gerhard Muchow, Berlin (donated to the Museum, 1951)
signature: “MACHT.PAUL / HAINLEIN [master’s mark: standing rooster, initials ‘P.H’] NVRNBERG / 1684”; garland ornamented with flowers and leaves; upper border of garland ornamented with raised shells; pattern on rim indistinct. Ring for missing stay; at its base engraved buds with pyramid.****
dimensions: be 122; length of last two portions of tube 700; thickness of metal 0.3
remarks: Only last two parts of tube and two ferrules, remain. Garland has engraved blossoms and leaves; upper border of garland has shell motif.
